notes: Front page INID fields (19) to (52), including the running title, the barcode caption line, the inventor, the correspondence address, the PCT and priority data and both classifications. Line 1 is the document title heading written by the enrichment pass and lines 2 to 5 are blank or the p01 page comment; rule 8 puts them in the surrounding section rather than in one of their own. This patent is in English throughout, so heading_text_zh is null on every section of this map.

The abstract states the transformation in one sentence, preparing 3-bromomethylbenzoic acids of formula II by brominating the corresponding 3-methylbenzoic acids, with no reagent, no conditions and no charges. contains_procedure is true because that is still one transformation and A2 rule 5g says an unconditioned transformation is a record; expect no_conditions on it. The IMAGE_EXTRACT at line 42 is the drawn formula II of the abstract and carries no molecules, because the vision pass correctly refused a SMILES for a Markush generic.

Paragraph [0001], the one-sentence field orientation, plus the running title repeated at the head of page 2. It names the same transformation the abstract does but as an orientation rather than as a procedure, so contains_procedure is false. This is a judgement call and it is recorded rather than silent: reading it as a procedure would produce a third near-identical generic bromination record that adds no fact the abstract and the summary do not already carry.

Paragraph [0002], prior art only. Three distinct prior-art transformations are named and A2 should read all three as prior art rather than as the invention: the WO 99/06339 bromination of methyl aromatics with azocarboxylic esters or azonitriles plus an oxidizing agent; the EP-A 0 292 944 radical bromination of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate in carbon tetrachloride; and the hydrolysis of that ester to the free acid. The Houben-Weyl reference to side chain bromination in general is a textbook citation rather than a fourth procedure and is not counted. No section of this patent carries a drawn scheme, so there is no route-attribution ambiguity anywhere in this document.

Paragraphs [0003] to [0008]. [0003] states the need and then the finding, that 2-halo-3-methyl-4-alkylsulfonylbenzoic acids can be brominated directly to the 3-bromomethyl acids in very good yields and very high purities. [0004] and [0005] give the transformation with the drawn formulae II and I, and [0006] to [0008] give the two alternative reagent systems: A) N-bromosuccimide with a radical initiator, and B) elemental bromine with photolamp irradiation. Two variants of one transformation, so two steps. The two IMAGE_EXTRACT spans at lines 61 and 65 are formula II and formula I and carry no molecules, both being Markush generics.

Paragraphs [0009] to [0011], the R-group definitions governing formulae I and II: R1 is fluorine, chlorine or bromine, and R2 is (C1-C4)alkyl. A1 rule 8 forbids emitting an R-group substituent fragment as a compound, so this section should yield no compound record at all unless a fully enumerated name appears in it, and none does.

Paragraphs [0012] to [0019], the generic process description: initiators, solvents, temperature range, the order of addition for each variant, reaction time and workup. [0016] gives an ordered operational procedure for variant A and [0017] one for variant B, so two steps, and they are generic restatements of the same two transformations the Summary states rather than new chemistry. Type is summary_of_invention because the content is the technical solution and its key parameters; the label differs so it stays unique. This section straddles the page 2 to page 3 boundary: [0019] opens at line 93 and its second half is the unmarked continuation at line 98, which is why the range crosses the page comment at line 96 rather than stopping at it.

Paragraphs [0020] to [0024], the compound claim in the description: compounds of formula II are novel except 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, which the patent attributes to EP-A 0 292 944, and that compound is then excluded from the genus. One fully enumerated compound name is present here and is extractable; the R1 and R2 definitions repeated at [0022] and [0023] are not. The IMAGE_EXTRACT at line 102 is the drawn formula II, again a Markush generic with no molecules.
Paragraph [0025], the single sentence introducing the worked examples. Kept as its own section rather than folded into Example 1 because it introduces both examples and belongs to neither.

One example, two independent worked procedures for the same product: Process Variant A) at [0027] with its yield at [0028] and purity and melting point at [0029], and Process Variant B) at [0031]. Two steps rather than one, because each has its own charge of starting material, its own vessel, its own reagent system and its own outcome. They are alternatives, not sequential steps, so neither is the other's precursor. Variant B reports only an HPLC composition and isolates nothing, so it has no yield and no product mass. This patent uses centred EXAMPLE N headings and Process Variant A) or B) subheadings, not the numbered inline markers of the form N followed by an ideographic comma that the A0 prompt describes; that description belongs to the reference patent and does not apply here.

One worked procedure, Process Variant A) only, making the ethylsulfonyl homologue. Note the printed heading order is inverted relative to Example 1: [0032] Process Variant A) is printed BEFORE the centred Preparation of title rather than after it. Recorded because it is a property of the document. Two IMAGE_EXTRACT spans sit at lines 144 and 146, after [0034] and before the claims. They are the drawn formulae II and I belonging to CLAIM 6, printed above the claim text by the two-column layout, so they are semantically the claims' and not this example's. Rule 7 forbids opening a section at an IMAGE_EXTRACT span and forbids leaving one stranded between sections, so they are filed here with the disagreement recorded rather than resolved. Both carry no molecules, being Markush generics.

Claims 1 to 20, of which 1 to 5 are printed as cancelled and carry no text. Two independent process claims, 6 for variant A with N-bromosuccimide and a radical initiator and 13 for variant B with elemental bromine and photolamp irradiation, so two steps; claims 7 to 12 and 14 to 18 are dependent and add conditions rather than transformations, and claims 19 and 20 are compound claims and carry no transformation. There is no What is claimed is heading printed anywhere; the claims begin abruptly at 1-5 (Canceled). Lines 197 and 198 are the five centred asterisks that end the document, as printed and as the EN line under it.
